design_evidence.independent_structural_validation: NOT ESTABLISHED for this I-girder/slab/U detail under concurrent V–T/M/N
method_gaps: No code-derived full stress field with concrete strut/node/splitting checks at the U-to-slab closure.
The shared concrete-flow ceiling and longitudinal allocation are declared LP bounds, not an established safe lower-bound theorem for the actual member.
No verified six-resultant resistance about the retained CSI reporting point (M2/V3 are excluded from this model).
No justified LRFD resistance-factor treatment for the proposed combined method or verified physical end D-regions.

research_basis.source: Zhang, Wang & Lin, 2017 MOC & ISICT, pp.148–156
research_basis.scope: Pure torsion; rectangular 150 x 250 mm beams, U plus crosstie with 135-degree hooks. Not project-specific V–T validation.
Overlapping hoops under monotonic torsion. 90-degree-hook post-peak ductility differs; not validation of this 90-degree U/slab detail.
STM requires defined load paths, struts, ties, nodes and anchorage. A complete justified STM may be used without a full nonlinear slip solver; the present LP does not meet that standard.
